beats.say: Walter Koenig passed away on Sunday 25 October 2026 in Los Angeles.
The Chicago born actor was 90 years old and left a legacy that spanned decades of science fiction history.
Variety says his co star George Takei paid a moving tribute to his long time friend.
Takei told his friend to keep navigating a steady course as the world remembered their bond.
Their friendship was so deep that Koenig even served as the best man at Takei's wedding in 2008.
While many knew him for his earlier work, Variety reports he won a Platinum Award for Best Actor just this year.
His final win for the film Mr Fleischmann shows he was an acclaimed performer until the very end. Walter Koenig passed away on Sunday 25 October 2026 in Los Angeles.
